The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is used to store items and has 25 slots of capacity. All items stored in a location will be accessible to all workstations in that area automatically and can be reviewed by opening the player inventory when in the area. For more information see [[storage]].

Horizontal and vertical : 4 x 2

Rotation : No
